info.title: Transformer ratio and winding polarity
info.question: How do turns, coupling and dots change the secondary signal?
info.expected: The loaded secondary follows the primary with winding losses and leakage; reversing its dot reverses the signal.
info.try: Select T1 for ratio, coupling, winding L/R and dot polarity. Inspect both winding voltages/currents and stored magnetic energy.
info.limitation: Linear mutually coupled windings with series resistance and dot polarity. No core saturation, hysteresis, losses beyond winding resistance or isolation rating. Coupling below one gives a positive-definite inductance matrix.

waveform_model.limitations: Ideal grounded voltage sources with per-component periodic sine or linear pulse ramps. No output resistance, current limit, battery discharge, noise or physical generator identity. Finite pulse high/low phase lengths include rise/fall respectively. Output sampling can alias; internal integration resolves waveform features within its work budget.

power_model.battery: Linear charge reservoir: OCV=Vfull*q/Q; Q=3600*capacity_Ah; ESR voltage sag. Equivalent stored energy=Q*Vfull*SOC^2/2. No chemistry, temperature, ageing, self-discharge, protection or physical ratings. Positive delivered current discharges; externally forced charging is an ideal reversible reservoir, not a charger model. Startup SOC is 0..1; live SOC outside that range is reported, not hidden.
power_model.motor: Generic brushed DC motor: armature RL, reciprocal Ke=Kt electromechanical coupling, rotor inertia, viscous friction and load. No brushes, commutation ripple, thermal model, gearbox or hardware ratings.
power_model.optocoupler: Generic LED/phototransistor optocoupler: separate conductive input/output ports, CTR and smooth saturation. No isolation-voltage rating, capacitance, propagation delay, temperature or ageing model.
power_model.transformer: Linear mutually coupled windings with series resistance and dot polarity. No core saturation, hysteresis, losses beyond winding resistance or isolation rating. Coupling below one gives a positive-definite inductance matrix.
